description: This file defines the EmployeeSalary entity class for the OrangeHRM project, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and including properties related to employee salary information such as pay grade, currency, amount, pay period, comments, and related direct debit details.

classes.name: EmployeeSalary
classes.description: Represents an employee's salary record with ORM mappings, including relations to employee, pay grade, currency, pay period, comments, and direct debit details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the salary record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the salary record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee entity associated with this salary record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this salary record.

methods.name: getPayGrade
methods.description: Retrieves the pay grade associated with the salary.

methods.name: setPayGrade
methods.description: Assigns a pay grade to the salary record.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Retrieves the currency type for the salary.

methods.name: setCurrencyType
methods.description: Sets the currency type for the salary.

methods.name: getPayPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the pay period for the salary.

methods.name: setPayPeriod
methods.description: Assigns a pay period to the salary.

methods.name: getSalaryName
methods.description: Retrieves the name or component of the salary.

methods.name: setSalaryName
methods.description: Sets the name or component of the salary.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves any comments associated with the salary record.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Assigns comments to the salary record.

methods.name: getDirectDebit
methods.description: Retrieves the direct debit details associated with this salary.

methods.name: setDirectDebit
methods.description: Associates a direct debit record with this salary.
